The public definition-change commit supports the UPGRADE interpretation; the particular running commit remains inferred.

resolution.reason: The reporter claims success after adding franka_msgs to find_package, but neither an exact provider revision nor a revision-identified resolved consumer is supplied in the public report. That is reported success, but does not satisfy S1's stricter requirement that both resolved units be identified by revision. The specification's date-derived provider SHA is not source confirmation of the running revision.
